app_info.name: Taher Ali Enterprises Wholesale Portal
app_info.context: B2B Wholesale E-Commerce Portal for Pickles, Biscuits, and Pure Ghee with Tier Discounts and WhatsApp Order Dispatch

key_features: Interactive wholesale product catalog with quantity selectors (Pickles, Biscuits, Pure Ghee)
Live shopping cart with instant totals, case size multiplier support, and item customization
Bulk quote calculator with tier discounts (e.g., 5% off for 10+ units, 10% off for 25+ units, 15% off for 50+ units)
WhatsApp instant order generator to phone 6305486808 with formatted order summary
Order checkout modal with business details, delivery address, payment terms, and WhatsApp confirmation
About & Contact sections highlighting Mohammed Abdullah Bilal, Hyderabad location, and interactive map placeholder
Light/Dark theme switcher with persistent local storage
Data-testid attributes on all interactive elements for rigorous automated testability
universal_guidelines: Do not use universal transitions (transition: all)
Ensure high contrast and accessibility for all text and hover states
Never use full transparent backgrounds without blur/scrim in headers or modals
Maintain data-testid attributes on all interactive elements
